d: Long, flowing salmon-pink hair with straight-cut bangs and a side-swept fringe frames a face with a youthful, mature expression and bright cerulean blue eyes. This person has a slender, feminine build and wears a white and gold bustier topped with a white choker and translucent, ruffled white fabric draping over the shoulders. A small red star-shaped charm hangs from the collar, and the character is posed against a background of ethereal blue and white crystalline structures.
